reviews.x: The cap on this product states that it is aluminum-free but the actual product received is the regular kind.  It's a great antiperspirant nonetheless and I'll keep it, but I'm not happy that it's not the same product being advertised.

reviews.t: This is the white solid not the clear solid!
reviews.x: This product is not pictured or advertised correctly. It shown as a clear solid and the one that I received is a white solid. Please update your photo to reflect the correct item. The one that has the clear cap is a clear solid and the one with the solid gray cap is a white solid.
Pictured and described as a deoderant.  But was actually an antiperspirant. Not a fan of antiperspirants so product was useless to me.
Im currently sitting in the back of a police car, but I ain’t scared. I’ve got my Dove deodorant, even if I don’t get out for awhile, at least I’ll smell Dove clean.
Pleasant odor.  Works as an anti-perspiration and deodorant

reviews.t: This smells like Speed Stick - nothing special
reviews.x: I've had the darnedest time getting a Dove+MEN deodorant/antiperspirant to be as good as the fresh scent that they have discontinued. Now DOVE has the Extra Fresh which is really just very soft - so you go through it VERY fast and the performance isn't any better. This Minerals+Sage scent is just the Mennen Speed Stick scent - nothing special. I will continue to try the other scents offered and see what I find. If you like the Speed Stick scent, get this one.
This produce advertises being aluminum free but it's 100% not

reviews.t: CONTAINS ALUMINUM THEIR PHOTO IS DECEIVING!!!
reviews.x: NOT ALUMINUM FREE AS SHOWN IN THEIR PICTURE!!!!! We chose not to use aluminum in our under arm care because of medical studies show major health risks. I bought this because the picture had a label that said aluminum free. I checked on their listed ingredients phot and it did not show any aluminum. Very, very disappointed in this seller trying to get rid of old stock with showing a new & improved version photo. The seller is trying to rid stock thinking “hey half the people won’t even  try to re

reviews.t: For all human people, not just male humans
reviews.x: Me, a lady, not a man, has been using this for years and love it. Dove, maybe you can just make deodorant for Humans. You don't need to make it specific to men or women, we all sweat and can all benefit from this product.  Ladies: buy this for yourself. They put more active ingredient in these men's products than they do in the women's. Do they think women don't sweat as much as men? Idk, but get more out of your deodorant for the same price. This scent is pretty nice also.

My 13 year old son can only use this deodorant so far. He has very sensitive skin, so other deodorants have made him break out. Luckily, it lasts as well. I make him shower every day, so I know it lasts at least 24 hours, even when he gets sweaty. His only complaint is that it feels “slippery”; I don’t know if this product comes in a form that has a more “powdery” or dry feeling?

reviews.t: Be careful. This has aluminum zirconium which may affect your skin
reviews.x: Be careful. This has aluminum zirconium (the main ingredient for antiperspirant) which may affect some people's skin differently. Which happened to me. For 3 days my armpits were extremely itchy, red, and with small irritating bumps. I don't think this is the product's fault all honestly since the problem is my skin. SO BE CAREFUL.

Good for daily use. But if you plan on going to the gym for a heavy work out, I wouldn't recommend this. It worked fine for my partner when he's doing cardio, but as for me, my underarms smell bad during my gym workout. To each his own I guess

!!!!BUYER BEWARE!!!! The order I received was the solid white antiperspirant with the gray top and not the solid blue deodorant with the clear top as pictured. So if you're looking for the deodorant you might want to buy from somewhere else.

I ordered this product because the picture claims it’s Deodorant, not antiperspirant. When the product arrived, it was, in fact Antiperspirant and not the Advertised Deodorant. I will be returned. Correct you false advertising.

I wish I would have looked at the reviews before purchasing. I’ll still use the product cause I love the scent but it is the white stick deodorant rather than the clear gel type of stick that is advertised in the picture.

reviews.t: NOT AS PICTURED- DIFFERENT PRODUCT-NOT ALUMINUM FREE
reviews.x: I was excited to find the non-aluminum deodorant version available for subscribe and save. However when I received my first order it was the antiperspirant, with aluminum as the main ingredient. Extremely frustrated.

The 1st product picture shows new aluminum free formula, and that's the whole reason I purchased this particular dove mens product.  However I was sent the old formula with aluminum as the #1 active ingredient.

reviews.t: Men+Care is a great product line
reviews.x: I love Dove Men+Care. This product smells great, goes on easily (although the deodorant and antiperspirant is smoother), smells great, and is long lasting. Definitely recommend and would purchase again.

reviews.t: You will be sent incorrect product
reviews.x: As mentioned in countless other reviews, this is the white colored stick and not the clear colored stick as advertised in the photo. Is it really that difficult to upload the appropriate product photo??

reviews.t: Solid antiperspirant at a good price
reviews.x: Does what it's supposed to do at a great price. Good percentage of aluminum zirconium not the highest concentration but good enough for the price. And more than enough for the average person.

reviews.t: Price was great on 4 of them.
reviews.x: I love the smell of this antiperspirant. But I've noticed it is starting to sting my arm outs, maybe I need to get use to it. It last longer than my brand I've been using. It was unscented.
False advertising. Doesn't exist. I was really excited to see a version of Dove Men's deodorant without aluminum, but there's a reason I hadn't seen it in the store; it doesn't exist.
This was not the dried ant I ordered or match the pic? The pic has a clear cap and the photo attached is the dark cap. Disappointed I can’t find the clear cap anywhere
Exactly what I needed and saved me a trip to the store, my husband loves this scent and can’t find it often so i just keep repurchasing here and it really helps me!
I really like it, it has a nice light coating, not too much of a residue. I like the scent. It's the best underarm deodorant I ever used.

claims.text: Many reviewers report receiving a product that does not match the listing, specifically a white solid antiperspirant instead of the pictured clear deodorant.
Several reviewers state the product is not aluminum-free despite advertising claiming it is.
Some reviewers report the product is an antiperspirant rather than the deodorant they expected.
Positive reviewers say it works well as a deodorant and antiperspirant with a pleasant scent.
A few reviewers mention skin irritation or performance issues, such as itchiness or not lasting through heavy workouts.
